tbesh_html:
A woman living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.4.4; married to Lappidoth (H3941)
§ Deborah = "bee"
1) the nurse of Rebekah who accompanied her from the house of Bethuel
2) a prophetess who judged Israel

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Deborah, the name of two Hebrewesses
strongs_1890.derivation: or (shortened) דְּבֹרָה; the same as H1682 (דְּבוֹרָה);
